items.response:
You're welcome. Enjoy the rest of your evening with Biscuit.
Action: Nothing further.

Saved: penicillin allergy (hives) and seasonal allergies in May, managed with Reactine. I'll keep it in a private medical note so it's easy to find when a form or clinic asks.
Action: Create a medical note with those two items.

I'll put in the pickup order, but I don't have your list yet and I don't know which store is near Te Aro. Grocery pickup orders need to be in by 14:00, so I'll check the time and that store's earliest slot before I promise 15 minutes.
Action: Check the time and the nearest store's pickup availability, then ask what goes in the order (or reorder your usual) before I submit it.

You're welcome. For your mom's mithai I'd go with Brijwasi Sweets: Rs 1,450 plus Rs 120 delivery, the best freshness reviews, and same day if it's ordered before 14:00 IST. I just need her delivery address.
Action: Hold the Brijwasi order until you send her address.

Try this: 'Thirty-one years of keeping Riverdale running, and you made it look easy. Thank you, and enjoy the time that is finally yours.' It's warm without any greeting-card phrases, and Sam can swap in one specific memory of her to make it his.
Action: Send Sam the line, and rework it if he wants it drier or funnier.

Swapping it now: the Wednesday 6:00 spin class at Spin Society comes off, and strength training at the Leslieville YMCA goes on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6:15 am, with a leave-by alert so you're home by 7:15 for Sam. I'm building tomorrow's focus playlist from Khruangbin and A. R. Rahman instrumentals.
Action: Delete the recurring spin event, create the two YMCA events with the 7:15 home deadline, and send you the playlist link.

Night, Riya. Congrats again on shipping Instant Payouts.
Action: Nothing further tonight.

Here's a draft: 'To Neha and her person: they say love is finding someone who laughs at your jokes, and Neha, you found someone who laughs at them on purpose. May you always share the blanket, the remote and the last samosa. Cheers!' I don't have the partner's name, so that's a placeholder for now.
Action: Fill in the partner's name once you send it, and trim or sharpen the jokes to taste.

Done on the call: a recurring Sunday 9:00 am Toronto time (6:30 pm in Mumbai) block with your mother Anjali, kept clear permanently. I'll also make sure your Tuesday 19:00 lesson with Carlos is on the calendar. For Spanish between lessons, I'd do short daily sessions of 10-15 minutes: real-life conversation role-play with me, then a quick review of whatever tripped you up in the last lesson with Carlos. What I don't know is your current level, so I'll start with a quick check.
Action: Create the recurring Sunday 9:00 am block, confirm the Tuesday 19:00 Carlos lesson is on the calendar, and start with a short level check.

Congratulations on the half marathon, 2:04:37 on the Toronto waterfront is a huge first, and good on Marcus for dragging you through it. I'll set a Friday 15:00 reminder for the #payouts-launch status update (due by 16:00) and pre-draft the five red/amber/green bullets from Linear, and keep Friday evenings clear for pizza and movie night.
Action: Create the recurring Friday 15:00 reminder, block Friday evenings, and save your race result (2025-10-19, 2:04:37) to your notes.

Ha, a coat at your desk is the clearest possible sign. Hope facilities sorts it out soon.
Action: Nothing needed unless you want me to send facilities a quick note about the thermostat.

I don't have the numbers from 13 Dec saved here, and I'd rather not guess at the bag's exact amounts. Scaling one dozen to three dozen is just multiplying every ingredient by 3, and you'd bake in batches rather than adjust the time.
Action: Look back through our 2025-12-13 chat and your notes for the recipe; if I can't find it, send me the amounts off the bag and I'll triple them right away.

Try: 'If a payout fails because of a bank-side error, the system shall automatically retry it without merchant action.' It keeps the requirement intact and drops the nested clauses.
Action: Swap it into the PRD once you OK it.

Here's a menu for 5 with no shellfish anywhere: baked brie with cranberry and thyme to start, a mushroom and spinach Wellington with roast potatoes and maple carrots as the main, and a dessert that can be made ahead. For Grace, a Pomegranate Rosemary Fizz: pomegranate juice, a squeeze of lime, rosemary syrup, topped with non-alcoholic sparkling wine, so she has a real toast drink. It's all make-ahead friendly and not fussy.
Action: Save the menu to your notes and look up where to buy non-alcoholic sparkling wine nearby.

Welcome to Vancouver. What you booked is Air Canada ref QX7L2P for you, Sam and Leo, $1,947.66 CAD total. The earlier fares I have noted (WestJet $642, Air Canada $689 return) were for the August long weekend dates, before the trip moved to 9-13 July, so they're not a like-for-like comparison. I don't have a record of what the Lafourcade song thing was, so I'd rather check than guess.
Action: Search our earlier chats for the original flight search and the Lafourcade request, then send Kabir a comparison with the right dates and ask you to remind me about the song thing if I can't find it.

Reminder set for 17:15. For the 1:1, Tom owns the series, so I can't edit it, but I'll accept his new Wednesday 11:30 series starting in January and remove the old Thursday copy from your calendar.
Action: Add the 17:15 reminder, accept the new Wednesday series, delete the Thursday copy, and check Wednesday late mornings for clashes.

Added both to Thursday's to-do list: the backsplash decision for Nate and the Morse Street pizza lunch and field trip forms, all due Fri 30 Jan. I don't have a note of what you looked at last spring for Ottawa, so I won't guess, but the Canadian Tulip Festival typically runs in May and may be what you saw. I'll confirm the dates and look for other family events that weekend.
Action: Add the two items to Thursday's list, search your notes and email for what you saved last spring, and look up what's on in Ottawa the May long weekend.

I'll reorder the Purina Pro Plan Sensitive Skin & Stomach in salmon, and I'll check the listing carefully so it isn't a chicken-based or other flavour. Enjoy the Anki cards.
Action: Find the listing, confirm 'salmon' in the title and ingredients, match the bag size from your last order, place the order, and send you the confirmation.

A few things to pass on: get on several waitlists at once, including licensed home daycare agencies, which often move faster than centres. Ask each place whether it's in the $10/day program, and about infant spots that open as kids move up.
Action: Look up Roncesvalles-area home daycare agencies and send you a short list for Diego's partner.

Got it: the Lattice mid-year self-review is due 2026-07-10, and it's already on my list from your earlier note. I'll remind you to start it next week and again the week it's due.
Action: Set a start reminder for next week and a second one for the week of 2026-07-10.

Here's a draft: 'Hi, thanks for organizing the street party! I can take the 2-4pm volunteer slot at the lemonade table, but I won't be able to help with setup. Looking forward to it. Riya'
Action: Save it as a draft for you to look over, and send it on your go-ahead.

I'll tell Hannah yes, Jun can come over Saturday from 1 to 4. For a rainy afternoon: a blanket and cardboard fort, a LEGO build-off with a timer, an indoor scavenger hunt, then a movie for the last hour so nobody needs refereeing.
Action: Text Hannah that Saturday 1-4 works, put it on the calendar, and put the activity plan in a note for you.

I'll find a half-hour window Monday to Wednesday that works for you, Aisha and Diego. Following your rule, the meeting will be 25 minutes inside that window, with an agenda in the invite: 1) negative balances, 2) reversed transfers, 3) what to size first. Aisha prefers async Slack to meetings, so I'll also post the agenda in a Slack thread to her so she can pre-read.
Action: Check all three calendars for a Mon-Wed slot, send the 25-minute invite with the agenda, and post the agenda to Aisha on Slack.

Glad Biscuit is okay. Aisha prefers async Slack threads to meetings, so I'd take this to her in a Slack thread: propose cutting payout nicknames and the scheduled-payouts calendar view from Monday the 25th's sprint, and ask her to reply by Thursday.
Action: Draft the Slack message to Aisha for your OK, then set a Thursday reminder to check her answer.

Jess should weigh these:
- Cash flow: would rent cover mortgage, condo fees, property tax and insurance, with a buffer for vacancies?
- Taxes: renting can affect the principal-residence exemption for those years, and rental income is taxable.
- Market view and plans: selling locks in today's price; holding is a bet on appreciation, and renting keeps the option to move back.
- Landlord effort: tenants, repairs, and what happens if things go wrong.
An hour with an accountant or planner would help.
Action: None.

I'll scan your docs for links to the old pricing page. I don't have either URL saved, so I'll get the old and new addresses from marketing's announcement or from a link already in the beta materials, then search Drive and Notion for matches.
Action: Find the old and new pricing URLs, search your beta materials and other docs for the old link, and send you a list of where it appears; I won't edit anything without your OK.

Draft: 'Hi Hannah! We're heading to the playground and the market at Riverdale Park East tomorrow around 10:30. Would you and the kids like to come along?'
Action: Hold it as a draft until you say send.

On the tours, Marcus's sister should ask: the staff-to-child ratio and how long staff have been there, what a typical day and nap routine looks like, how illness and sick days are handled, and how parents get updates. Also: fees and whether they're in the $10/day program, food and allergy policy, and how they handle settling-in for a one-year-old.
Action: Save that as a checklist in your notes so you can forward it to Marcus.

25-minute timer started for the garden beds.
Action: Start a 25-minute timer and alert you when it ends.

I'll log it as the Toronto Waterfront Half Marathon, October 19, 2025, 2:04:37, as the official result. I'll also set up the yearly recap so it's ready in December.
Action: Add the entry to your running stats and set a December reminder to build the yearly recap.

Ugh, standing the whole way with someone's backpack in your face is a rough start to the day.
Action: Nothing needed.

On it. I'll tell your mom the new time kindly: starting this week, Saturdays at 8:30 am Toronto time, which is 6:00 pm for her, and let Kabir know too. I'll update the recurring event with both Toronto time and IST. One thing to check first: my note has Leo's soccer on Saturdays at 9:00 with arrival at 8:45, which could clash with an 8:30 call, so I'll confirm his schedule.
Action: Reply to Mummy with the new time, update the recurring calendar event (8:30 am Toronto / 6:00 pm IST), message Kabir, and check Leo's soccer schedule against the Saturday slot.

Great. Nate still needs the wall choice by Monday, so I'll gather fresh options for the wall behind the range and sink this afternoon.
Action: Put together a shortlist of options this afternoon so you can send Nate a link before Monday.

Okay, the charcoal bag order stays on hold until you've talked to Sam. Whenever you're ready, tell me which appliances are set up in the basement and I'll put together five easy dinners and a short shopping list.
Action: Keep the order on hold and wait for your word.

I'll rename the Scan_*.pdf files in Downloads by the date each was scanned, in the format YYYY-MM-DD, with a number added if two share a day.
Action: List the Scan_*.pdf files, read each one's scan date from its metadata (falling back to the modified date), rename them, and show you the before and after list.

Here's the drill sheet plan, in role-play scenes (ordering food, a work meeting, a doctor's visit) with Mexican vocabulary like carro and computadora. Section 1: ser vs estar with emotions and locations. Section 2: por vs para. Section 3: the subjunctive after cuando for the future, so 'cuando llegue a casa, te llamo', not 'llego'.
Action: Build the one-page sheet with exercises and an answer key and save it to your notes before your next lesson with Carlos.

A heat warning means two or more days of very hot weather are expected, and an extended heat warning means three or more days, so it's the same threshold lasting longer. In southern Ontario the trigger is roughly daytime highs around 31 with overnight lows of 20 or more, or a humidex of 40 or higher. The precautions are the same, but plan for several hot nights in a row.
Action: None.

Rule of thumb: a retention curve has flattened when the drop from one period to the next is tiny and stays tiny, for example under about 1-2 percentage points per period (or a few percent relative) for several periods in a row. It should be levelling out at a non-zero floor, and you want it in every recent cohort, not just one. Check that the cohorts are big enough that the noise isn't hiding a slow decline.
Action: None.

I'd start with ChessKid: it's built for kids around 6 to 12, moderated, with lessons and puzzles, and the paid tier is the main upsell rather than ads. Lichess is a free no-ads fallback, though it's less kid-oriented. Listings change, so I'll check the current app store pages for ads and in-app purchases before you install.
Action: Check the current listings and reviews for ads, loot-box-style purchases and age fit, and send you the final pick.

I'll update Biscuit's vet to Dr. Kaur at Riverside Veterinary Clinic on Broadview Ave, replacing Dr. Moreau. Then I'll look for an appointment for his annual shots and rabies booster next week, on a weekday after 5:30 pm. I don't have the clinic's phone or booking link yet, so I'll find those.
Action: Update Biscuit's vet contact, check Riverside's availability next week after 17:30, check your calendar, and book the best slot.

Boxes you have. For the fort you'll want packing or duct tape, a box cutter for you and safety scissors for Leo, markers or paint, clothespins or binder clips to hold flaps, blankets and pillows for inside, and a flashlight or string lights.
Action: Save that as a checklist in your notes so you can check what's already at home.

EFT is the broad term for any electronic bank-to-bank transfer. In Canada, what people call EFT is mostly batch payments like direct deposit and pre-authorized debit, cleared through Payments Canada's batch system. ACH is the US term for similar batch rails, so people use it loosely for the Canadian equivalent. Wires are a separate, faster system for large payments.
Action: None.

I'll check that the Disney+ charge stopped after you cancelled in March 2026, using your cancellation confirmation and your statements. I'll also record your current subscriptions: Netflix (standard), Spotify Family, Crave and The Globe and Mail digital.
Action: Search email for the Disney+ cancellation confirmation, check statements for any Disney+ charge after it, and save the subscription list to a note.

You're welcome. One thing to remember: the camper health form and the authorized pickup list still aren't marked complete in the City's camp portal, and both are needed before day 1.
Action: Set a reminder to complete those forms before camp starts on Mon 29 Jun.

RRSP: you get a tax deduction now and pay tax when you withdraw, so it's best when your income today is higher than it will be in retirement. TFSA: you contribute after-tax money, growth and withdrawals are tax-free, and the room comes back, so it's more flexible.
Action: None.
